name: contract-initial-page-viewports
goal: Generate the initial page screenshot state at desktop, tablet and mobile without losing its existing behavior

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: New app and game plans emit only one initial-page screenshot despite the declared three-viewport page contract. Declare desktop 1440x900, tablet 920x800 and mobile 390x844 for this existing state before adding the two missing viewport cases.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing app-plan case checks screenshot presence but not viewport coverage. Strengthen that case and exact child-matrix counts; preserve its title, all parent cases, console monitoring, missing-baseline refusal and full-page matching.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 1d476db7da strengthens the existing app-plan case. Matched red 83c6170b06d5 fails Every initial-page viewport is explicitly declared; four other cases pass. Two extra generated device cases were declared before this checkpoint.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Source-only 5f12d367a1 emits desktop, tablet and mobile initial-page cases with the stable state title, shared console fixture and full-page screenshot comparisons.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged five-case command passes at 5f12d367a1 in the same environment as red 83c6170b06d5. Browser matrix qualification remains pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
